label: rearing
rationale: The mouse walks to the wall and stops, its head and forebody rise out of view up the wall so the outline shrinks to the hindquarters for about a second, then it drops back and walks along the wall at full length.

label: none
rationale: The mouse turns at the wall, bending its body into a curve with the head swinging back toward the tail, but the outline stays about as large as when it walks and the head never rises, so this is a turn, not a rear.

label: rearing
rationale: The mouse stops in the open and sits up: the outline shrinks to a small round head-and-shoulders shape with the tail trailing straight behind, holds for about a second, then lengthens as the mouse drops.

label: none
rationale: The mouse turns round on the spot by the wall, so for a moment it points toward the camera and looks compact, but its outline keeps its walking size and it keeps rotating instead of standing up.
